description: This file contains functions and logic for platform-specific firmware upgrade and identification processes for BCM4908 based devices. It includes functions for reading firmware content, identifying firmware format, validating images, and performing upgrades, including UBI-aware and raw flashing methods.

methods.name: get_content
methods.description: Reads specified number of bytes from a file at a given offset.

methods.name: get_hex_u32_le
methods.description: Reads a 4-byte little-endian 32-bit unsigned integer from a file at a specified offset and outputs it in hex.

methods.name: get_hex_u32_be
methods.description: Reads a 4-byte big-endian 32-bit unsigned integer from a file at a specified offset and outputs it in hex.

methods.name: platform_expected_image
methods.description: Returns the expected firmware image name based on device board name.

methods.name: platform_identify
methods.description: Identifies the firmware format and extracts relevant metadata from the firmware image file.

methods.name: platform_pkgtb_get_image_name
methods.description: Retrieves the image name from a pkgtb firmware using device tree get commands.

methods.name: platform_pkgtb_get_image
methods.description: Extracts image data from a pkgtb firmware image based on image name and offsets.

methods.name: platform_pkgtb_get_upgrade_index
methods.description: Determines the UBI volume index for upgrade based on the environment variable.

methods.name: platform_pkgtb_commit
methods.description: Commits the upgrade by updating environment variables and toggling the firmware slot.

methods.name: platform_check_pkgtb
methods.description: Validates that the required images (bootfs, rootfs) are present in a pkgtb firmware.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Validates the firmware image format, checks for device match, and verifies image integrity.

methods.name: platform_pkgtb_clean_rootfs_data
methods.description: Cleans the root filesystem data partition during a pkgtb upgrade.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade_pkgtb
methods.description: Performs upgrade of a pkgtb firmware, updating ubi volumes and committing changes.

methods.name: platform_calc_new_cferam
methods.description: Calculates a new cferam index and updates the corresponding file in bootfs.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade_ubi
methods.description: Performs a UBI-aware upgrade, including flashing boot and root filesystems, and updating cferam.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Main upgrade routine that identifies the firmware type and delegates to specific upgrade functions, or performs raw flash if needed.
